clips.title: The story
paras: Felix's Chest is a container of personal belongings lost by the exiled gnome Felix Whindlebolt during the flight from Gnomeregan. Carried away by Frostmane trolls lurking near Coldridge Valley, it sits abandoned within one of their primitive mountain camps.

When the subterranean techno-city of Gnomeregan fell to trogg incursions and toxic radioactive fallout, thousands of gnomes fled toward the snowy surface of Dun Morogh with whatever possessions they could carry. Felix Whindlebolt managed to escape the irradiated ruins, but amidst the panic of the evacuation, native Frostmane trolls scavenged the roads and overtook the scattered survivors. Felix lost his primary toolkits and belongings, with his sturdy chest hauled off to the crude camps the trolls maintain in the crags southwest of Anvilmar.
